title: Workplace investigation report CI-208 (fictional)
text: Avery Lund reported the raised voice on 2026-08-03. Jordan Tate heard Morgan Price raise his voice, but did not hear any insult. The project meeting on 2026-07-29 was attended by Avery Lund, Morgan Price and Jordan Tate. Because the witness statement and the meeting log are consistent with the complaint about a raised voice, the report records that allegation as corroborated.
